title: A decade of POCSO cases in Telangana: Over half remain pending trial as judicial backlog delays justice
description: Between January 1, 2016 and June 30, 2026, Telangana registered 31,117 cases under the POCSO Act. Of these, 16,348 cases, or 52.54%, remain pending trial, while another 2,863 cases (9.20%) are still under investigation.
